photos.desc: Commercial harvest of bigmouth buffalo for food. Fish are netted and then kept living in well-oxygenated tanks and trucked to markets in the US where they are sold alive.
Another extremely old bigmouth buffalo showing both black and orange spots. Both types of spotting accrue and intensify with age.
Photographed at Gavins Point National Fish Hatchery in Yankton, SD by Sam Stukel (USFWS).
